{
  "name": "alvearium",
  "displayName": "Alvearium",
  "version": "0.4.4",
  "description": "Alvearium (formerly session-board): one ticket board for all your Claude Code sessions and agents, terminal and claude.ai/code cloud: what waits on you, what is in progress, what to do next. Live updates, dependencies, priorities, who-talks-to-whom history and a feedback inbox.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Iskandeur",
    "url": "https://github.com/Iskandeur"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Iskandeur/alvearium",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Iskandeur/alvearium",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/Iskandeur/alvearium#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/Iskandeur/alvearium/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/Iskandeur/alvearium/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "agents",
    "cloud",
    "dashboard",
    "dependencies",
    "feedback",
    "hooks",
    "kanban",
    "mcp",
    "mod",
    "notifications",
    "priority",
    "realtime",
    "sessions",
    "statusline",
    "tickets"
  ],
  "mcpServers": {
    "tickets": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": [
        "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/mcp/server.mjs"
      ],
      "env": {
        "CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL": "${user_config.server_url}",
        "CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_TOKEN": "${user_config.token}"
      }
    }
  },
  "userConfig": {
    "server_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Board server URL (optional)",
      "description": "Base URL of your Alvearium server, e.g. https://board.example.com. Leave empty for local mode (this machine only).",
      "default": ""
    },
    "token": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Board server token (optional)",
      "description": "Bearer token of your Alvearium server. Leave empty for local mode.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
